name: ProxyPay
description: ProxyPay — Mobile Money to Stellar backend service. One-click Heroku deployment.

NODE_ENV.description: Node environment. Heroku controls this to `production` on one-click deploys.

STELLAR_NETWORK.description: Stellar network to target. Use `testnet` for evaluation or `public` for mainnet.

STELLAR_HORIZON_URL.description: Horizon endpoint(s). Single URL or comma-separated list (primary first, then fallbacks).

STELLAR_FEDERATION_DOMAIN.description: Domain served in federation addresses, e.g. alice*example.com

STELLAR_FEDERATION_SERVER_URL.description: Full base URL of this service (used in stellar.toml FEDERATION_SERVER line).

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Secret key protecting admin-only endpoints. Override with a strong random value.

OAUTH_JWT_SECRET.description: Dedicated secret used to sign OAuth JWTs.

DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Global AES-256-GCM key material for encrypting PII fields (>=32 chars).

PII_MASTER_KEY.description: Master key for per-user HKDF key derivation. Keep distinct from DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

GRAPHQL_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the /graphql endpoint (required in production).

STELLAR_ISSUER_SECRET.description: Funded Stellar secret key for the anchor issuer account.

STELLAR_SIGNING_KEY.description: Server signing secret key for SEP-10 challenge transactions.

STELLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Secret used to verify incoming Stellar webhook signatures.
